query:
SELECT 
  spm.id,
  spm.processId,
  p.name as processName,
  spm.entrada,
  spm.necesidades,
  spm.subprocesos,
  spm.salida,
  spm.createdAt,
  spm.updatedAt
FROM subprocessMaps spm
LEFT JOIN processes p ON spm.processId = p.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Diseño%' OR p.name LIKE '%Dise%'
ORDER BY spm.updatedAt DESC
LIMIT 5;
